# CyberJudah

> A King James Bible with the Apocrypha, cross-linked with the class notes, daily reading
> notes, encyclopedia, handbook of Bible law, precepts and case studies taught from it.
> Every chapter lists what cites it; every citation links back into the text.

The Bible text is the public-domain King James Version (1769) with the Apocrypha, 81 books, 1362 chapters.

## Pages

- [The Bible](https://cyberjudah.io/bible): every chapter, with the notes, laws, precepts and cases that cite it
- [4 Chapters a Day](https://cyberjudah.io/study): 1009 study notes on the daily reading, one page per chapter
- [Sabbath class notes](https://cyberjudah.io/classes): 100 classes
- [15 Minutes w/ The Captains](https://cyberjudah.io/captains): 10 episodes
- [Encyclopedia](https://cyberjudah.io/encyclopedia): 8 standing subjects gathered from the notes
- [The Law](https://cyberjudah.io/law): a handbook of Bible law in 22 parts, 1562 laws
- [Precepts](https://cyberjudah.io/precepts): 445 precepts with their references
- [Case studies](https://cyberjudah.io/cases): 217 judgments recorded in scripture, and 72 who kept the law and were blessed

## Data

Everything on the site is available as static JSON at the same versification as the pages.

- [API index](https://cyberjudah.io/api/index.json): every endpoint
- [Books](https://cyberjudah.io/api/kjv/books.json), chapters at https://cyberjudah.io/api/kjv/<book-slug>/<chapter>.json
- [Notes index](https://cyberjudah.io/api/notes/index.json): study, class, captains and encyclopedia notes
- Citations for a chapter: https://cyberjudah.io/api/concordance/<book-slug>/<chapter>.json
- [SQLite library with full-text search](https://cyberjudah.io/library.sqlite.gz)

## Feeds

- [Sabbath class notes](https://cyberjudah.io/classes/rss.xml)
- [15 Minutes w/ The Captains](https://cyberjudah.io/captains/rss.xml)
- [4 Chapters a Day](https://cyberjudah.io/study/rss.xml)
